title: Rudja, the Dread Engineer Boss Guide: Grenades, Tar Ignition and Safe Positioning
summary: Mawdun Mine boss tied to The Trail of Corruption. Master the Tar → Flamethrower ignition, Poison Gas chains, Flash Grenade blind and the enrage charge.
description: How to beat Rudja, the Dread Engineer in Path of Exile 2 Act 2: hazard interaction matrix, attack table, safe positioning and rescue step.
author: Exile2 Guides
imageAlt: Rudja the Dread Engineer surrounded by tar and fire in Mawdun Mine

sections.title: Remember These First
sections.callout: Do not stand in Tar when her Flamethrower is active — that is what turns the floor into burning ground.
calloutDetail: Rudja's danger comes from ground interactions, not just direct hits.
After the fight, free Risu to continue The Trail of Corruption.

answers.label: Before the fight
answers.text: Read the floor. Tar, Poison Gas and explosives each react differently to her fire.

answers.label: During the fight
answers.text: Keep moving off Tar before the Flamethrower; step away from Poison Gas before it chains.

answers.label: After victory
answers.text: Walk to Risu's cage and free her — the objective does not auto-complete.

steps.label: Reach Mawdun Mine
body: Follow the mine tunnels from the Outskirts.

steps.label: Trigger the encounter
body: Risu is caged nearby — note her position for after the kill.

items.label: Fire resistance
checks: Tar ignition and Flamethrower deal Fire.
items.why: Standing in Tar during the Flamethrower creates burning ground.
items.fix: Raise Fire res; do not linger on Tar.

items.label: Chaos / Poison coverage
checks: Poison Gas chains on fire contact.
items.why: Gas plus fire creates overlapping denial.
items.fix: Keep moving; do not stand in gas when she throws fire.

items.label: Recovery flask
checks: Blind from Flash Grenade costs you reads.
items.why: You may eat a hit while blind.
items.fix: Save a flask for after the flash.

items.label: Movement speed
items.fix: Boots with movement speed; pre-position away from walls.

sections.title: Arena Reading
paragraphs: The chamber mixes stable floor with Tar pools, Poison Gas pockets and explosive nodes. Rudja's fire is the trigger that turns safe-looking floor dangerous.
Treat every coloured patch as a state, not a decoration. The hazard matrix below maps each state to its trigger and your response.
bullets: Blue = stable floor. Orange = Tar (ignites on fire). Red = Poison Gas (chains on fire). Yellow = explosive node (delayed).

phases.label: Phase 1: Hazard Arena
notes: One continuous fight. Enrage adds a fast charge when her health drops.

attacks.name: Tar Grenade
telegraph: Lobs a Tar patch to the ground.
responses: Leave the Tar before her Flamethrower fires.
commonMistakes: Standing in Tar waiting for the Flamethrower.

attacks.name: Flamethrower
telegraph: Raises the torch and sweeps a cone.
responses: Be off any Tar in the cone path.

attacks.name: Poison Gas
responses: Move a second time after it appears — fire can chain it.
commonMistakes: Treating all green as one hazard.
notes: Gas + fire creates an extra explosion.

attacks.name: Flash Grenade
responses: Stop greed; recover position while blind.
commonMistakes: Continuing to attack through the blind.
notes: Blind reduces your reads, not direct damage.

attacks.name: Enrage Charge
telegraph: At low health she winds a fast dash.
responses: Move toward open space, away from walls.
notes: Fast and tracks; do not back into a corner.

types.label: Fire
mitigation: Fire resistance and staying off Tar.
notes: Flamethrower and ignited Tar are the main Fire sources.

types.label: Chaos / Poison
mitigation: Avoid Poison Gas when fire is active.

types.label: Physical
notes: Flash and charge are physical pressure.

sections.title: Strategy and Key Mechanics
paragraphs: Hazard Interaction Matrix — read the floor before the boss:
Tar Grenade → triggered by her Flamethrower → becomes burning ground → do not wait on Tar.
Poison Gas → triggered by fire → extra explosion/denial → leave a second move after it appears.
Flash Grenade → direct hit/blast → blind → stop greed, recover position.
Explosive Grenade → delayed blast → judge by landing marker, not colour → keep a gap.
bullets: Melee: punish after the Flamethrower sweep, not during it.
Ranged: kite around Tar; do not stand in the cone path.
Low mobility: pre-clear a safe lane so the enrage charge has somewhere to miss.

rewards.label: The Trail of Corruption (rescue)
notes: After the kill, walk to Risu's cage and free her.
The objective advances only after the rescue step — it does not auto-complete.

entries.question: Why does the floor suddenly become burning ground?
summary: Players stand in Tar and get ignited by the Flamethrower.
editorialAnalysis: This is the Tar + fire interaction, not a separate attack.
officialAnswer: Leave the Tar before the Flamethrower fires.

entries.question: Why did the gas explode when I wasn't near it?
summary: Poison Gas chains when her fire touches it.
editorialAnalysis: Gas plus fire is a chain, not two independent hazards.
officialAnswer: Move a second time after gas appears; do not assume it is safe.

entries.question: I beat her but the quest did not progress.
editorialAnalysis: The rescue is a manual step, not automatic.
officialAnswer: Walk to Risu's cage after the kill and free her.

problems.symptom: The floor keeps igniting under me.
directAnswer: You are standing in Tar when the Flamethrower fires. Leave Tar before the cone sweeps.
checks: Do not path through Tar during her fire.
Raise Fire resistance if it still hurts.

problems.symptom: I got blinded and ate a hit.
directAnswer: Flash Grenade blinds you; stop attacking and recover position while blind, save a flask.
checks: Keep a recovery flask for after the flash.

problems.symptom: The quest did not advance after the kill.
directAnswer: Free Risu manually — the objective does not auto-complete on kill.
